title: Smooth algebra homomorphisms lift across a henselian pair
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S$ a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], $A$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $(A,I)$ is a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Every $R$-algebra homomorphism $\tau:S\to A/I$ lifts to an $R$-algebra homomorphism $\widetilde\tau:S\to A$, meaning that the composite $S\xrightarrow{\widetilde\tau}A\to A/I$ is $\tau$.
